description: Long purple tailored outer robe/coated drape with wide gold geometric woven borders over a long cream undertunic with narrow purple/gold placket, cuffs and hem. Paired round shoulder clasps linked by short chain, patterned belt with round metal buckle and long fringed decorated textile end, dark trousers and tall brown leather boots. Both hands clasped visibly in front. No headgear, armor or weapon.
